summary: Configured Apache on node1 to serve the legacy report securely on TCP 8080. The configuration survived a full node reboot.
actions_performed: Published only public/ as the document root.
Mapped /cgi-bin/report to execute the supplied script.
Applied persistent SELinux contexts and opened TCP 8080 in firewalld.
Enabled Apache at boot and completed the mandatory reboot verification.

evidence.requirement: Execute the supplied report at /cgi-bin/report while preserving business output
evidence.summary: HTTP 200 text/plain response contains warehouse=west and open_orders=7, matching the original executable.
The root URL returns HTTP 200 with the staged Warehouse reports page.

evidence.requirement: Keep application source and private content outside published content
evidence.summary: DocumentRoot is public/; private, handover, CGI directory, and alternate source paths return 404. Only the explicit report endpoint is mapped for execution.

evidence.requirement: Provide a persistent service on TCP 8080 compatible with the installed legacy platform
evidence.summary: Apache is enabled and active, listens on TCP 8080, has a persistent firewall opening, and uses persistent SELinux labels.

evidence.requirement: Preserve the installed operating-system release and kernel

evidence.summary: Healthy baseline boot ID 555221a1-8680-433b-ba3e-ebc874545af1 was captured, reboot was acknowledged, new boot ID d112693b-fdbe-468d-a138-9963428c5985 was observed, and Apache, firewall, static content, CGI output, source integrity, and access isolation all recovered.
